scope_decline.q: Why is the number of loans in default so high?
Why did the number of transactions decrease in 1998?
What caused the spike in cash withdrawals in 1996?
Why do clients in Prague have higher salaries than elsewhere?
Explain why some accounts have negative balances.
What is the reason female clients take smaller loans?
How come loan status D is more common in north Moravia?
Analyze the factors that drive loan defaults and rank them by importance.
Which factors explain the differences in crime rates between districts?
Why is this count so high?
Figure out why account 8261 has so many transactions and recommend what to do about it.
Compare Prague and Brno and tell me which one performs better and why.
What would happen to loan defaults if average salaries rose by 10 percent?
Forecast the number of new accounts next year.
Do richer districts cause fewer loan defaults?
scope_decline.sql:
SELECT d.district_id, d.A11 AS average_salary,
       COUNT(l.loan_id) AS total_loans,
       SUM(CASE WHEN l.status IN ('B','D') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS default_loans,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN l.status IN ('B','D') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(l.loan_id), 2) AS default_rate_percent
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A11
ORDER BY d.A11 DESC;
scope_decline.detail: SELECT d.district_id, d.A11 AS average_salary,        COUNT(l.loan_id) AS total_loans,        SUM(CASE WHEN l.status IN ('B','D') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) A

scope_answer_plain.q: Which district has the highest number of loans in default (status D)?
scope_answer_plain.sql:
SELECT d.A2 AS district_name, COUNT(*) AS loan_count
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.status = 'D'
GROUP BY d.district_id
ORDER BY loan_count DESC
LIMIT 1;
scope_answer_plain.detail: SELECT d.A2 AS district_name, COUNT(*) AS loan_count FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.di

scope_answer_plain.q: Which month of 1996 had the most transactions?
scope_answer_plain.sql:
SELECT strftime('%m', date) AS month, COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM trans
WHERE strftime('%Y', date) = '1996'
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY cnt DESC
LIMIT 1;
scope_answer_plain.detail: SELECT strftime('%m', date) AS month, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM trans WHERE strftime('%Y', date) = '1996' GROUP BY month ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 1;

scope_answer_plain.q: What is the average loan amount in each region?
scope_answer_plain.sql:
SELECT d.A3 AS region, AVG(l.amount) AS average_loan_amount
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
GROUP BY d.A3;
scope_answer_plain.detail: SELECT d.A3 AS region, AVG(l.amount) AS average_loan_amount FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id

scope_answer_plain.q: Which client has the highest total loan amount?
scope_answer_plain.sql:
SELECT c.client_id, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN disp d ON d.account_id = a.account_id AND d.type = 'OWNER'
JOIN client c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
GROUP BY c.client_id
ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC
LIMIT 1;
scope_answer_plain.detail: SELECT c.client_id, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id JOIN disp d ON d.account_id = a.accou
